title: Create with Luvia: artisan application
description: Invited artisans can share their crochet and handmade skills for possible home-based, batch-by-batch work with Luvia Creations.
privacy: We use this application to assess your skills, contact you and coordinate a possible paid trial. It is private and accessible only to authorised administrators and our hosting/authentication providers. An application/session reference is stored for abuse prevention. Applications not approved are deleted after 180 days without an update; approved and inactive profiles are retained while needed for the working relationship and applicable legal obligations. Contact hello@luviacreations.com to request access, correction or deletion. Do not include identity documents, bank details, passwords, health information or another person's contact details. Portfolio links are reviewed for selection only; they do not give us permission to publish your work or story.
notice: Applying does not guarantee work or create an employment agreement. Each batch's scope, rate, quality requirements, delivery costs and deadline must be agreed before work starts. We start with a small paid trial: there is no application fee or trial deposit.
